title: M-APSK Demodulator Baseband
text: M -ary amplitude phase shift keying (APSK) demodulation, 2 inputs, 1 output, {Decision type} sets Demodulation; {Constellation points per circle} sets the constellation points per PSK ring, {Radius of each circle} sets the radius per PSK ring, {Phase offset of each circle (rad)} sets the phase offset per PSK ring, {Symbol mapping}, {Custom symbol mapping}, {Output type}, {Noise variance source}, {Noise variance}, {Output data type} and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: In
ports.summary: APSK modulated signal scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: Var
ports.summary: Noise variance positive scalar | vector of positive values

params.name: Constellation points per circle
params.values: Constellation points per PSK ring [4,12] (default) | vector

params.name: Phase offset of each circle (rad)
params.values: Phase offset per PSK ring [pi/4,pi/12] (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Symbol mapping
params.values: Symbol mapping Auto (default) | Contourwise-gray | Gray | User-defined

params.name: Decision type
params.values: Demodulation decision type Hard decision (default) | Log-likelihood ratio | Approximate log-likelihood ratio

params.name: Noise variance source
params.values: Noise variance source Property (default) | Input port

params.name: Noise variance
params.values: Noise variance 1 (default) | positive scalar | vector of positive values

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
